name: Higashisonogi (Japan)
description: A white field charged at the centre with the Higashisonogi town emblem in red: a winged device above a ring enclosing a disc.
history: Municipal flag of Higashisonogi, a town in Nagasaki Prefecture; like most Japanese municipal flags it shows the municipal emblem on a plain field. The municipal emblem was adopted in June 1968.

features.role: Higashisonogi town emblem — a winged device above a ring enclosing a disc
